anat.desc: Fullpath to 3D nifti image (in .img format) of the anatomical image.

func1.desc: List of fullpaths to 3D nifti image (in .img format) for the functional image of the run 1 (one file per time point).

func2.desc: List of fullpaths to 3D nifti image (in .img format) for the functional image of the run 2 (one file per time point).

events1.desc: Fullpath to a tsv file describing the paradigm of the run 1.

events2.desc: Fullpath to a tsv file describing the paradigm of the run 2.

slice_order.desc: Order in which the slices of the functional runs were acquired.

trials_ses1.desc: Fullpath to .mat file containing onsets for run 1.

trials_ses2.desc: Fullpath to .mat file containing onsets for run 2.
